services.name: Private Sunset Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy this 1.5 hour Private Sunset Dolophin Cruise with up to six guests! We'll look for dolphins while cruising the beautiful waters around Destin and see Destin's gorgeous Sunset. 1.5 hours Cruise Details Escape the Crowded Tours and enjoy a Private Cruise Bring up to six passengers Coolers onboard with ice so bring your favorite drinks and snacks USCG Licensed Captain will take you out to find Destin's Famous Dolphins to see them up close in their natural habitat! 6 people max • 1.5 hours • The Best Views of the Sunset in Destin • Find Dolphins

services.name: Private Firework Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy the Firework show on your private Cruise! One hour About Every Thursday from Memorial Weekend to Labor Day Weekend, Destin honors our military and our wounded Veterans with a spectacular fireworks show over the Destin Harbor. Come experience this awesome display on the water on our Private Fireworks Cruise. Let our licensed Captain take you on a Harbor Cruise before we find the perfect spot for you to enjoy the Fireworks display. Cruise Details Escape the Crowded Tours and enjoy a Private Cruise Bring up to six passengers Coolers onboard with ice so bring your favorite drinks All Ages! • One Hour! • Memorial Day - Labor Day • Thursdays • Up to Six Passengers
